item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Yash looks at the diagram of $\angle PQR$. He will measure $\theta$ with a protractor.

Which claim correctly states how he must place the protractor?

options.A: Put the protractor center on vertex $Q$, align ray $QP$ with the zero-degree line, and read the scale reached by ray $QR$.
options.B: Rest the protractor anywhere on ray $QP$ and read a scale mark for $\theta$.
options.C: Say that reading a degree number is what creates $\angle PQR$ on the page.
options.D: After reading $\theta$, treat that same reading as also fixing every unmarked angle at $Q$.
